text: {"headline":"Provider 1000000269 bills 99215 at roughly three times the risk-adjusted expectation, with over half of those claims on patients with 0–1 chronic conditions, but records came back for too few 99215 claims to confirm or rule out upcoding.","leaning":"inconclusive","interpretation":"The complexity breakdown points toward upcoding: this provider's 99215 share exceeds the all-provider share in every complexity band, including patients with no chronic conditions. The documentation does not show unsupported billing: the three documented 99215s (C0168060, C0168445, C0168765) record high MDM, and no notes claiming moderate-or-higher data review lacked a lab or test line. But three charts is far too thin to judge, and records cover only a small share of claims. A reviewer should first request charts for the low-complexity 99215 claims listed, especially the 0-condition acute-symptom visits, and check whether the notes support high MDM or time, or look templated."}
